newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Staff at Morocco's BMCI bank hold sit-in.
newsitem.headline: Staff at Morocco's BMCI bank hold sit-in.

text.p: Staff at Morocco's Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce et de l'Industrie held a 24-hour sit-in on Monday in the bank's headquarters in Casablanca to protest against the laying off of three employees, a spokesman said.
The employees are members of the independent Union Marocaine du Travail trade union (UMT).
"We are protesting against the non-respect of employees' dignity and pressing for pay increases and other benefits," a spokesman affiliated to the UMT said.
He said 1,300 workers had held two one-day strikes in the bank's 77 branches this year to push for similar demands with no result.
The sit-in would only involve about 700 members of Casablanca offices but could spread to other cities if their demands were not met.
Last week, staff at state-owned farmers credit bank Caisse Nationale de Credit Agricole (CNCA) went on a two-day strike to press demands for improvement of employees' conditions.
